rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: CEC Chairman A. Veshnyakov announces that the early presidential election took place on 26 March 2000, that 39,740,434 voters voted for registered candidate Putin Vladimir Vladimirovich, more than half of those who took part, and that the CEC recognised the election as valid and resolved to consider Putin elected President.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Constitutional Court Chairman M. Baglai states that under the Constitution the President takes the oath set out in Article 82 on assuming office, in the presence of members of the Federation Council, State Duma deputies and Constitutional Court judges, and asks Putin to take it; Putin recites the oath.
rows.locator: Transcript, Baglai's invitation and Putin's oath

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Baglai then declares that, in accordance with the Constitution, Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin has assumed the office of President of the Russian Federation; the presidential standard is raised, and Yeltsin, introduced as the first President of the Russian Federation, says the new President has officially assumed office and hands him the President's badge.
rows.locator: Transcript, immediately after the oath; Yeltsin's remarks

bounded_scope: Presidency observations for CLAUDE-C01-14 only. Election calling, voting, result determination, declaration, correction and publication, oath, stated assumption of office, inauguration ceremony, resignation, acting service and outgoing-holder statements stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The C01-05 RSFSR roles and the USSR packet are outside this extract.
